title: Race
description: A VIDEO GAME FOR TWO, in the disk menu's words. 4 recovered forms; the disk form plays.
language: TRS-80 BASIC; extensions may be needed
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: RACE EARLY
versions.note: validated source; runtime untested. Ordered lines, consistent pointers, normal end marker; matching variants/repeated saves; runtime untested
versions.unavailableReason: Another recovered save; the site offers one selected player.
versions.startupSource:
5 CLS
10 FOR X=0 TO127:SET(X,3):SET(X,47):NEXTX:FORY=3TO47:SET(0,Y):SET(127,Y):NEXTY
25 DEFINT A-Y
26 GOTO 200
30 LL=.0001
50 P=0
60 X=5:Y=10
65 ON ERROR GOTO 1000
70 M=PEEK(14400):IF MAND128THENP=0ELSEIF MAND1THENP=1ELSEIFMAND2THENP=2ELSE IF PEEK(14464) THEN 500
80 IF MAND8THENY=Y-1ELSEIFMAND16THENY=Y+1
90 IF MAND32THENX=X-1ELSEIFMAND64THENX=X+1
95 X=XAND127:IFY<0THENY=0ELSEIFY>47THENY=47
